stories.why_it_matters: Key fact to remember: The projection was made in the IEA's World Energy Outlook 2026, released today (19 November). This is the one to carry into BCS/Bank questions on the economy and banking.
stories.exam_facts: Bangladesh and Pakistan's combined natural gas imports are projected to rise by around 70% to approximately 80 billion cubic metres (bcm) by 2035, as declining domestic production and rising demand increase their dependence on imported fuel, according to the International Energy Agency (IEA). Under its Current Policies Scenario (CPS), combined gas imports by Bangladesh and Pakistan are expected to reach around 80 bcm in 2035, driven by rising demand and declining output from mature domestic gas fields. New projects, particularly in the United States and the Middle East, are expected to expand export capacity, potentially pushing the global LNG surplus to its highest level around 2030. The United States, currently the world's largest LNG exporter, could account for around 35% of global LNG supply by 2035 under the CPS.

stories.summary: US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping attend a bilateral meeting at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, China, Nov 19, 2026. Trump, Xi agreed that military AI decisions should involve humans, Bessent says

stories.exam_facts: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed humans should always be involved in military decisions that use artificial intelligence technologies, even as the two countries compete for AI supremacy, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Friday. He added that US AI labs needed to maintain their technological lead as the best defence against "dangerous" Chinese AI models that are being used in cyberattacks. "But there's nothing to do with competition when it says that both sides agree that no major military operation should be launched without a human being involved," Bessent said.
